$schema.description:
Optional: the JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can check
it as you type (`"$schema": "../schema/recipes.schema.json"`).

action.description: The id of the action that follows it, like `"cut"`.

from.description: The id of the structure it acts on.

material.description: What the result is made of. Optional: `kept` if left out.

needs.description:
Tool levels it needs, all of them, like `{ "WELD": 1 }`. Optional:
none if left out.

seconds.description: How long it takes, in seconds.

to.description: The id of the structure it becomes.

uses.description: The items it uses up. Optional: none if left out.

RecipeMaterial.description: What material the new structure is made of.

oneOf.description: The same as before (a door cut open is still aluminium).

The material of the first item used (a crack patched with steel
scrap is patched with steel).

Use.description:
Some items a recipe uses up: `count` of the item type `item`, made of
any material.
